data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin providing access to NFC features on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to check NFC availability, start and stop NFC sessions, and interact with various NFC tags and card types across Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: Building an app that needs to read or write NFC tags
Integrating Near Field Communication features on both Android and iOS
avoid_when: You do not need hardware-level device features like NFC
You only need barcode or QR scanning (use camera instead)
strengths: Cross-platform support for both Android and iOS
Provides platform-specific and abstract tag classes
weaknesses: Requires manual native permission configuration for Android and iOS
Breaking changes between major versions require code updates
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NFC permissions and entries to AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist/Entitlements for iOS.
